options.content:
**Adjudicated** panels are recomputed gauges over the *newest revision of the newest finalized run per scope* (environment, route, guardrail, policy_version, suite). Label corrections lower numbers; nothing here is an ever-increasing counter.  
**FPR = FP/(FP+TN)**, **FNR = FN/(FN+TP)**; shown as *N/A* when the denominator is 0. **Missing data is shown as `no data`, never as 0 errors.**  
Results on a curated, attack-heavy suite are **benchmark numbers, not production rates**. `synthetic=1` means the guardrail under test is a fixture.  
Detector accuracy (TP/FP/FN/TN), enforcement (did a detected violation still reach the client?) and delivery (what the client got) are separate columns on purpose: a model refusal is not a guardrail block, and an HTTP status is not a verdict.

panels.title: Live traffic - signals to investigate (ordinary requests, no labels)

options.content: Computed from the probe trail on ordinary traffic over the evaluator's window (`PASSIVE_WINDOW_S`, default 15 min). **Nothing here is a verdict**: without labels a block cannot be called wrong, only unusual. Each number is a place to look. The same data with the evidence behind it: evaluator `/passive/summary`; drawn as a chain: evaluator `/chain`.

panels.title: Signals (warn)
panels.description: Signals marked warn in the window. See the table below for which.

panels.title: Coverage findings
panels.description: AI routes with no guardrail, a disabled guardrail, a guardrail present on peer routes but not here, or no probes.

panels.title: Suspected fail-open
panels.description: Requests allowed after spending about the guardrail's configured timeout in its gap, with no decision recorded.

panels.title: Ran without a decision
panels.description: The guardrail's position was reached but it recorded no verdict.

panels.title: Flagged but still served
panels.description: Expected in detect-only mode; a slip if the guardrail is meant to block.

panels.title: Guardrail config changes
panels.description: Changes of the guardrail config fingerprint seen in the window. Compare block rate before and after in /passive/summary.

panels.title: Share of requests stopped or altered, per guardrail
panels.description: (blocked + altered) / reached. A jump is either an attack wave or overcatching: sample the affected requests.

panels.title: Time spent in each guardrail (p95)
panels.description: Timestamp difference between the probes on either side of the guardrail. Missing for guardrails that share a gap.

panels.title: Guardrail chain share of gateway time (median)
After a block: what the same caller did next
panels.description: Retries that get through after a block: callers rephrasing honest requests (overcatch) or stepping around the block (slip).

panels.title: Bodies rewritten across a guardrail
panels.description: Hash of the request (or response) differs between the probes around the guardrail.

panels.title: Tokens and request facts in the window
Findings in plain language (POST /passive/translate; Claude API, Bedrock, or the offline translator)
Adjudicated results - latest run per scope
True positives (violation flagged)
panels.description: Violations the guardrail flagged.

panels.title: False positives (benign flagged)
panels.description: Overcatching at the detector level.

panels.title: False negatives (violation missed)
panels.description: Let-slip at the detector level.

panels.title: Inconclusive / excluded / error
panels.description: Units with no matrix classification (missing verdict, not_run, unrelated failure, timeout). Never counted as TN.

panels.title: Labeled coverage
panels.description: Share of units that got a binary classification.

panels.title: FPR = FP/(FP+TN)
panels.description: Omitted by the evaluator when FP+TN = 0 -> shows N/A.

panels.title: FNR = FN/(FN+TP)
panels.description: Omitted by the evaluator when FN+TP = 0 -> shows N/A.

panels.title: Confirmed enforcement failures
panels.description: Detected violations that still reached the client (detect-only mode, late stream abort, dispatched to model).

panels.title: Benign blocked or altered
panels.description: Client-visible overcatch damage (separate from FP count).

panels.title: Manifest reconciled
panels.description: 1 when adjudicated units == runner manifest.

panels.title: Synthetic fixture under test?
panels.description: 1 = results come from a deliberately faulty fixture guardrail used to validate the evaluator.

targets.expr: sum by (category, outcome) (go_eval_units_by_category{environment=~"$environment", route=~"$route", guardrail=~"$guardrail", policy_version=~"$policy_version", suite=~"$suite", outcome=~"TP|FP|FN|TN"})

panels.title: Traffic volume, guardrail actions and stages (all observed requests, labeled or not)
Observed requests by guardrail verdict
panels.description: Verdict announced by the observer adapters (allow/deny/detect/not_run/unknown). Passive traffic shows actions and coverage only - never FP/FN rates.

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (count_over_time({service_name="guardrail-evaluator", environment=~"$environment", route=~"$route", guardrail=~"$guardrail", stage=~"$stage", category=~"$category", event_type="kong_observation"}[$__auto]))

panels.title: Observed requests by route and stage

targets.expr: sum by (route, stage) (count_over_time({service_name="guardrail-evaluator", environment=~"$environment", route=~"$route", guardrail=~"$guardrail", stage=~"$stage", category=~"$category", event_type="kong_observation"}[$__auto]))

panels.title: Kong proxy requests (native prometheus plugin)
panels.description: From Kong's bundled prometheus plugin scraped on :8100. Status codes alone never prove allow/block.

panels.title: Evidence gaps per request (observer-reported)
panels.description: Requests whose observation lists at least one gap (request body in file, exit without attribution, adapter error...).

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (count_over_time({service_name="guardrail-evaluator", environment=~"$environment", route=~"$route", guardrail=~"$guardrail", stage=~"$stage", category=~"$category", event_type="kong_observation"} | json | gaps != "[]" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Gateway duration (observer access->log), p50/p95/p99
panels.description: Measured inside Kong by the observer: first access handler (priority 790) to log phase. Excludes client<->Kong network and nginx pre-access time.

panels.title: Client latency (runner), p50/p95
panels.description: Measured by the runner: request sent to last byte received, including the model.

options.content: Overhead is measured by **A/B routes** in `scripts/perf.sh` (identical route with and without the observer plugins), reported as the difference of client-side p50/p95 and of Kong's own `kong_request_latency_ms`/`kong_kong_latency_ms`. In-band numbers above include the model and cannot isolate the observer.

panels.title: Export outbox by destination/status
panels.description: pending/failed growing = destination outage. Queues are independent per destination.

panels.title: Unmatched observations after join timeout
panels.description: kong_without_runner: gateway saw a signed test request the runner never reported. runner_without_kong: http-log batch lost/late (worker-local queue, not durable).

panels.title: Case drill-down (adjudications, newest revision first) - expected vs verdict vs delivery
panels.description: Loki keeps every revision; filter by run_id and take the highest revision per case. Click a row's request_id to pivot into kong_observation events.

{service_name="guardrail-evaluator", environment=~"$environment", route=~"$route", guardrail=~"$guardrail", stage=~"$stage", category=~"$category", event_type="adjudication"}
